canonical.title: Stakeholder Communication and Reporting: AI Playbook for BAs, FAs, and POs

parent.title: Practical AI Playbook for Business Analysts, Functional Analysts, and Product Owners (2026)

siblings.title: Requirements elicitation and discovery
siblings.summary: A practical guide to requirements elicitation techniques, process, common pitfalls, and AI augmentation for BAs, FAs, and product owners.

siblings.title: User story and acceptance criteria authoring
siblings.summary: Practical guide to writing user stories and acceptance criteria: formats, INVEST quality checks, splitting patterns, Three Amigos, Definition of Ready, and anti-patterns to avoid.

siblings.title: Functional specification and documentation
siblings.summary: Tool selection, EARS notation, spec-driven pipelines, and prompt patterns for BAs/FAs/POs writing AI-augmented functional specs in 2026.

siblings.title: Backlog and prioritisation support
siblings.summary: AI handles scoring, grooming, and feedback synthesis; POs own the value trade-offs — practical prompt bank and tool comparison for the 2026 BA/PO workflow.

siblings.title: Validation, testing alignment, and risk
siblings.summary: Risk-based testing prioritizes business impact over coverage metrics; continuous validation ensures requirements stay aligned with implementation.

siblings.title: Tooling landscape and integration
siblings.summary: The 2026 tooling landscape has shifted from static automations to autonomous AI agents; success depends on layering the right integration, analytics, and no-code tools for your role.
